# `scripts/fp/render/`

[Index](index.md)

## `scripts/fp/render/hlod.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

Visibility ranges and building LODs (slice G2). post_pass() classifies every drawn part of a tile holder once (building, prop or road), sets its visibility range and shadow casting, and caches the list so a preset switch never walks the scene again. Buildings have three levels: the real textured model up to VIS_BUILDING_NEAR, a merged one-draw twin of each building mesh (midlod.gd) up to VIS_BUILDING, then stepped mass proxies (proxies.gd) merged into one mesh per 8x8-tile chunk. Each switch happens at one exact distance from the same point, so levels never overlap. Sparse kinds (parks, wind farms, solar, rubble) have no useful far shape and never number many: theirs stay full-detail at every distance (Cls.FULL). While the camera is aerial (the city overview, a high photo fly), road mains and twins lose their end so the street grid reaches the horizon; set_aerial() switches that, render_opt re-ranges the cache.

### Enums

- `Cls { BUILDING, PROP, ROAD, NEAR, MID, FULL }`: BUILDING / ROAD: holder parts ending at VIS_BUILDING; NEAR: a building or road mesh ending at VIS_BUILDING_NEAR; MID: its merged twin, from VIS_BUILDING_NEAR to VIS_BUILDING; FULL: a sparse kind's part, always drawn (no far representation exists and there are never many).

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `PROXIES = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/proxies.gd")`
- `MIDLOD = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/midlod.gd")`
- `SHADER = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/impostor.gdshader")`
- `CHUNK = 8`
- `FULL_KINDS = [D.PARK, D.WIND, D.SOLAR, D.LANDFILL, D.RUBBLE]`: Sparse kinds whose models would proxy badly (a park is not a box) and whose tiles never number many: drawn in full at every distance instead of popping to nothing at VIS_BUILDING.
- `SMALL = 0.05`: Meshes smaller than this (longest side, world units) never cast shadows (1 m).
- `PROP_SCENES = ["res://models/real/props/", "res://models/props/"]`
- `ROAD_SCENES = "res://models/real/roads/"`
- `IMPOSTOR_SERVICES = [D.HALL, D.HOSPITAL, D.SCHOOL, D.POLICE, D.FIRE, D.UNIVERSITY, D.TRAIN, D.COAL, D.PUMP,...`: Service kinds drawn as far impostors (the closed ones; sparse ones are Cls.FULL instead).
- `SOLID_SERVICES = [D.HALL, D.HOSPITAL, D.SCHOOL, D.POLICE, D.FIRE, D.UNIVERSITY, D.TRAIN]`: Closed services that occlude (G2 contract: solid kinds).

### Properties

- `vis_building: float`: Visibility ranges in world units after the preset multiplier.
- `aerial: bool`: Aerial coverage on: the camera is over the city (render_opt decides), so road mains and twins draw to the horizon. Cached parts are re-ranged by render_opt through apply_ranges().
- `tiles: Dictionary`: tile index -> entry {"holder", "gis": Array of GeometryInstance3D, "cls": PackedByteArray, "chunk": Vector2i, "path", "xf": Transform3D (model to world), "center": Vector3 (the engine's range point of the main mesh), "impostor": bool, "solid": bool}
- `chunk_tiles: Dictionary`: chunk -> {tile index: true}
- `chunk_nodes: Dictionary`: chunk -> MeshInstance3D
- `waiting: Dictionary`: Tiles whose building waits for a mid-LOD merge (tile index -> true); re-run post_pass when ready.
- `walks: int`: Test hooks: holders walked by post_pass, and chunk meshes built.

### Functions

- `func setup(p_view: CityView, p_sim: CitySim, p_root: Node3D) -> void`
- `func set_ranges(building: float, near: float, prop: float) -> void`: Sets the switch distances used from now on (cached parts are re-ranged by apply_ranges).
- `static func chunk_of(i: int) -> Vector2i`
- `func post_pass(i: int, holder: Node3D) -> Vector2i`: Classifies and ranges every drawn part of tile i's holder (replacing its mid-LOD twins); returns the tile's chunk, whose impostor and occluder need a rebuild.
- `func warm(holder: Node3D) -> bool`: Does one piece of the cold work post_pass(i, holder) would otherwise do inline: the model's proxy, or one source mesh's mid-LOD gather. A gather's surface_get_arrays reads back from the GPU and waits for the frames in flight (10 to 140 ms for a building's first instance); one gather per step keeps that to one stall, splitting it by surface costs a stall per surface. True if it did something; false once post_pass will find everything cached or under way.
- `static func tile_of(holder: Node3D) -> int`: The tile a holder stands on (holders sit at their tile's centre).
- `func drop(i: int) -> Vector2i`: Forgets tile i (its holder was replaced or cleared); returns its chunk.
- `func set_aerial(on: bool) -> void`: Switches the aerial road coverage; cached parts are re-ranged by render_opt's job queue, and post_pass applies the new value to every tile it passes from here on. The impostor chunks cast shadows only while aerial (from the street the sun's reach ends well inside VIS_BUILDING).
- `func apply_ranges(e: Dictionary) -> void`: Visibility ranges of one cached entry at the current distances. While aerial, road mains and twins lose their end (the street grid reaches the horizon); everything else keeps its ladder.
- `static func restore(e: Dictionary) -> void`: Restores what post_pass changed on one entry: no range, shadows as authored, no g2 metas.
- `func rebuild_chunk(c: Vector2i) -> void`: Rebuilds the merged impostor mesh of chunk c from the cached entries.
- `func set_visible(on: bool) -> void`: Shows or hides every impostor.
- `func clear() -> void`: Frees every impostor and forgets every tile.

## `scripts/fp/render/midlod.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

Mid-range building LOD (slice G2): a building mesh's surfaces merged into one, each carrying its material's average colour (proxies.json, else albedo_color) as vertex colour, with generated LODs. A building is one draw call instead of 17 to 30 between VIS_BUILDING_NEAR and VIS_BUILDING, where its textures are down to their smallest mips anyway. Merges run on the WorkerThreadPool (the main thread only copies the arrays and uploads the result); cached per source mesh, which every instance of a model shares. proxy_bake.gd bakes the merges offline into BAKED_DIR: copying a mesh's arrays reads them back from the GPU and waits for the frames in flight (10 to 140 ms), so the runtime merge is only the fallback for a model without a fresh bake.

### Constants

- `PROXIES = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/proxies.gd")`
- `SHADER = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/midlod.gdshader")`
- `WebSupport = preload("res://scripts/ops/web_support.gd")`
- `GLASS_PREFIXES = ["Glass", "Window"]`
- `LIT_PREFIXES = ["WindowLit"]`
- `MIN_SURFACES = 3`: A mesh with fewer surfaces gains too little to replace.
- `BAKED_DIR = "res://models/real/midlod/"`
- `MODELS_DIR = "res://models/real/"`

### Properties

- `threaded: bool`: false builds on the calling thread (tests).
- `use_baked: bool`: false ignores BAKED_DIR and always merges at runtime (tests).

### Functions

- `static func mergeable(src: Mesh) -> bool`: True when src is worth merging.
- `func mesh_for(src: Mesh, path: String) -> ArrayMesh`: The merged mesh for src, or null while it is being built (the build starts on the first call). path is the model's scene path (building or road piece, for the baked colours).
- `func started(src: Mesh) -> bool`: True once src's merge is built or under way (mesh_for() then does no gather).
- `func poll(deadline: int = -1, clock: Callable = Time.get_ticks_usec) -> int`: Uploads finished builds; returns how many. With a deadline (clock() µs) it uploads at least one and starts no further upload once the deadline has passed.
- `func pending() -> int`: Builds still running.
- `func wait_all() -> void`: Waits for every running build and uploads it (tests, teardown).
- `static func baked_path(src: Mesh, path: String) -> String`: Where proxy_bake.gd stores the merge of src, a mesh of the model at path.
- `static func load_baked(src: Mesh, path: String) -> ArrayMesh`: The baked merge of src, or null when there is none or it was baked from another version of src.
- `static func fresh(baked: Mesh, src: Mesh) -> bool`: True when baked was merged from src as it is now (same surfaces, same bounds).
- `static func merged(src: Mesh, path: String) -> ArrayMesh`: Merges src on the calling thread and tags the result with what fresh() compares (the bake).

## `scripts/fp/render/occluders.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

Occluders (slice G2): one ArrayOccluder3D per 8x8-tile chunk inside one OccluderInstance3D, holding a box per solid building (hlod.gd's "solid" entries): the body box from proxies.gd, inset 15% of its width on every side and cut to 0.8 of its height, so a box never hides what shows past the building's edges. The nodes live under World/Occluders, never under CityView.

### Constants

- `INSET = 0.15`
- `HEIGHT = 0.8`
- `FACES = [[0, 1, 3, 2], [4, 6, 7, 5], [0, 4, 5, 1], [2, 3, 7, 6], [0, 2, 6, 4], [1, 5, 7, 3]]`

### Properties

- `chunk_nodes: Dictionary`: chunk -> OccluderInstance3D
- `chunk_boxes: Dictionary`: chunk -> Array[AABB] (world boxes in the chunk's occluder; test hook)

### Functions

- `func setup(p_root: Node3D) -> void`
- `static func shrink(body: AABB) -> AABB`: The occluder box for a body box: inset in x and z, from its base up to HEIGHT of it.
- `func rebuild_chunk(c: Vector2i, hlod: RefCounted) -> void`: Rebuilds chunk c's occluder from hlod's cached tile entries.
- `func set_visible(on: bool) -> void`: Shows or hides every occluder.
- `func box_count() -> int`: Number of occluder boxes in every chunk.
- `func clear() -> void`

## `scripts/fp/render/proxies.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

Building proxies for far impostors and occluders (slice G2): per model path, the body box and a low-poly stepped mass mesh template (tops coloured by what covers each cell, facades by the model's average facade colour) built from the offline bake in proxies.json (proxy_bake.gd). A model missing from the bake falls back to the bounds of its non-foliage surfaces. Model space: the GLB root's own space, before the holder's building_xform.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `BAKE = "res://scripts/fp/render/proxies.json"`
- `SKIP_PREFIXES = ["Leaves", "Leaf", "Bark", "Hedge", "Tree", "Grass", "Turf"]`
- `FALLBACK_WALL = Color(0.55, 0.54, 0.52)`
- `FALLBACK_ROOF = Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.31)`

### Functions

- `static func bake() -> Dictionary`: The baked data of every model (loaded once per process). {} when the bake file is missing.
- `func proxy(path: String, model: Node3D = null) -> Dictionary`: The proxy of a model: {"verts": PackedVector3Array, "normals": PackedVector3Array, "colors": PackedColorArray, "win": float (glass share of the facade), "body": AABB (main mass), "baked"}. model is an instance of the scene at path, used only for the fallback (may be null).
- `func cached(path: String) -> bool`: True when path's proxy is built (proxy() returns it without work).
- `func has_mass(path: String, model: Node3D = null) -> bool`: True when the model has a proxy with some mass (always true for baked models).

## `scripts/fp/render/proxy_bake.gd`

extends `SceneTree`

Offline bake of building proxies for G2's far impostors and occluders. Run by hand, headless: godot --headless --path . -s res://scripts/fp/render/proxy_bake.gd For every building model it writes into proxies.json, in the model's own space (lot centred on the origin, ground at y = 0): a GRID x GRID height field of the building mass (lot slab, foliage and props excluded) with the colour of the surface on top of each cell, the facade colour, the share of the facade that is glass and of that the share that lights up at night, and the body box (the main mass: cells at least half the building's height, or H's ColBox_<n> empties when present), and the average colour of every material (midlod.gd's vertex colours). Then, with those colours, every mesh midlod.gd would merge at runtime, merged into MIDLOD.BAKED_DIR (stale files removed). Colours are the materials' albedo_color times the average of their source albedo images (read from the source files here, never from the VRAM-compressed imports at runtime). Re-run after a model changes; the runtime falls back to surface bounds for any model missing from the file.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `AP = preload("res://scripts/fp/asset_paths.gd")`
- `MIDLOD = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/midlod.gd")`
- `PROXIES = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/proxies.gd")`
- `OUT = "res://scripts/fp/render/proxies.json"`
- `DIRS = ["res://models/real/zones/", "res://models/real/buildings/"]`
- `ROAD_DIRS = ["res://models/real/roads/"]`: Road pieces get material colours only (midlod.gd twins), no proxy.
- `GRID = 16`
- `HALF = 0.5`
- `BAND_H = 0.02`: Facade colour bands (world units) and the base split for buildings at least TALL high.
- `BANDS = 200`
- `TALL = 0.3`
- `BASE_MAX = 0.2`
- `SKIP_PREFIXES = ["Leaves", "Leaf", "Bark", "Hedge", "Tree", "Grass", "Turf"]`: Surfaces that are not building mass (by material or node name prefix).
- `GLASS_PREFIXES = ["WindowLit", "Glass_Shop", "Glass_Office", "Glass"]`
- `CAR_MATERIALS = ["Glass_Car", "Rubber", "Car_Paint"]`

## `scripts/fp/render/quality.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

First-person quality presets (slice G2): the knobs each preset sets, and the static helpers every slice reads without a feature lookup (vis_mult, max_street_lights, camera_far). The render_opt feature applies a preset at runtime; G1's light profile owns the Environment and Sun values.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `NAMES = ["low", "medium", "high"]`
- `DEFAULT = "medium"`
- `PRESETS = { "low": { "scaling_mode": Viewport.SCALING_3D_MODE_FSR2, "scale": 0.59, "msaa": Viewpo...`: Per preset: 3D scaling (FSR2 also brings its own temporal AA, so MSAA stays off), directional shadow atlas and filter, SSAO and SSIL quality and half size, the VIS_* multiplier, the first-person camera far plane, the mesh LOD threshold (pixels of error) and G1's street lights.
- `COMPAT = { "low": {"scale": 0.77, "msaa": Viewport.MSAA_DISABLED}, "medium": {"scale": 1.0, "msa...`: The Compatibility renderer (the web build) has no FSR2: on the desktop GL driver setting it crashes the engine as the first frame draws. It scales bilinearly instead, with no temporal pass to hide aliasing, so the scale stays near native and MSAA (its only 3D antialiasing) stands in for FSR2's TAA.
- `WEB_DENSITY = {"traffic": 12, "crowd": 24, "animals": 6}`: Density ceilings the web quality tier (flag web_quality) publishes for the traffic, crowd and animal owners to clamp their budgets to; each owner tunes its own number with before/after FPS evidence. The render knobs of the tier land separately.
- `AERIAL_FAR = {"low": 80.0, "medium": 110.0, "high": 110.0}`: How far the camera must see while it is over the city (the overview lifts it up to 32 u, and a photo fly can go higher): past every visible ground point at the lowest pitch, with margin. Low keeps the tightest plane that still covers the overview horizon (the low_vram budget): at the default pitch nothing lies past 80 at any city size, and only pitches under ~45 degrees over cities wider than ~90 tiles lose a far slice, where 110 would cost Low +1 to +9 ms of GPU.
- `AERIAL_SHADOW_SPLITS = [0.4, 0.6, 0.8]`: Sun shadows while the camera is aerial reach as far as the aerial plane on Forward+, so the city keeps its shadows from the sky (the impostor chunks cast them then: one low-poly draw per chunk and cascade). On Compatibility every cascade redraws each shadowed mesh in the forward pass, and a full aerial reach there costs hundreds of draws, so its reach caps tighter. Low drops the pass entirely: at the overview's 26 u altitude a sub-26 m frustum casts nothing anyway (measured: reach 24 == shadows off, draw-for-draw), and the pass is ~660 draws plus 1-2 ms of render CPU the 2-core web box cannot spare. Every nonzero cap sits clear of the street profile's 8/12/16 reaches, so render_opt's street-value snapshot never mistakes one for the other. The cascade splits stay fractions of the reach: the camera hangs over the roofs, so the nearest ground is far from the lens (split 1 is all a 2-split preset uses).
- `COMPAT_AERIAL_SHADOW = {"low": 0.0, "medium": 48.0, "high": 64.0}`: Aerial shadow reach per preset on Compatibility; 0 means the sun's shadow pass is off while aerial (render_opt disables it and restores the street state on exit).

### Functions

- `static func normalize(preset: String) -> String`: The preset name itself when known, else DEFAULT.
- `static func knobs(preset: String) -> Dictionary`: Every knob of a preset (unknown names give the default preset).
- `static func is_web() -> bool`: True in the browser export.
- `static func web_mode(web: bool = false) -> bool`: Web tier active: the web build with flag web_quality on. web forces it on in tests.
- `static func density_caps(web: bool = false) -> Dictionary`: Density ceilings for the web tier: {} off the web or with the flag off (owners keep their current budgets then). GRIDFALL_WEB_CAPS="traffic=8,crowd=16" overrides single values so profiling can bisect without a rebuild (desktop gl_compatibility runs); unknown keys are ignored.
- `static func is_compat(method: String = "") -> bool`: True when the running renderer is Compatibility (the web build, or a desktop run with --rendering-method gl_compatibility). method overrides the running one (tests).
- `static func viewport_knobs(preset: String, method: String = "") -> Dictionary`: The viewport's 3D scaling knobs for a preset on a renderer: the preset's own (FSR2) on Forward+, COMPAT's bilinear scale and MSAA on Compatibility.
- `static func vis_mult(preset: String) -> float`: Multiplier on every WS.VIS_* range: 0.7 / 1.0 / 1.3.
- `static func max_street_lights(preset: String) -> int`: Street lights G1 keeps lit around the player: 6 / 12 / 16.
- `static func camera_far(preset: String) -> float`: First-person camera far plane in world units: 45 / WS.CAMERA_FAR (60) / 75.
- `static func aerial_far(preset: String) -> float`: The far plane while the camera is aerial (render_opt's aerial coverage), never below the street-plane value.
- `static func aerial_fog_end(preset: String) -> float`: Depth-fog end while the camera is aerial, inside 95% of the aerial far plane (the same rule the street profile applies to its own plane: light_profile.fog_end).
- `static func aerial_shadow(preset: String, method: String = "") -> float`
- `static func street_fog_end(preset: String) -> float`: The street fog end for a preset (light_profile.fog_end's rule, for restoring it on exit).

## `scripts/fp/render/render_opt_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

Render performance (slice G2): applies the quality preset (FSR2 scaling, shadow atlas and filter, SSAO and SSIL quality, mesh LOD threshold, camera far plane) and restores every knob on teardown; on foot it ranges every tile holder's parts (hlod.gd), draws far buildings as merged chunk impostors and culls with per-chunk occluders (occluders.gd). Tile post-passes queue on tile_built and run under a per-frame budget (FRAME_BUDGET_USEC), followed by at most one chunk rebuild. Aerial coverage: once the camera is AERIAL_MIN above the hero (the city overview lifts it, and so does a photo fly), roads, open construction sites, far trees, the fog end and the far plane widen so the city stays whole from the sky at every zoom. Every value is re-derived on exit, so a preset or weather change mid-air never leaves a stale value behind.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `Q = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/quality.gd")`
- `HLOD = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/hlod.gd")`
- `OCCLUDERS = preload("res://scripts/fp/render/occluders.gd")`
- `JOB_BUDGET_USEC = 3000`: A preset switch re-ranges cached parts for at most this long per frame.
- `WAIT_BUDGET_USEC = 2000`: Tiles re-passed per frame once their mid-LOD merges finish, at most this long.
- `FRAME_BUDGET_USEC = 2000`: Queued tile post-passes, mid-LOD uploads and the chunk rebuild share this much of a frame. A tick emission builds 10 to 40 tiles, so the queue drains within a few frames; one step always runs, so nothing starves on a slow frame.
- `AERIAL_MIN = 3.0`: The camera is aerial once it is this far above the hero's feet (60 m: over every roof), and stops once it sinks back below AERIAL_OFF (hysteresis, so the toggle never flaps at the line).
- `AERIAL_OFF = 2.4`
- `SITE_RESCAN = 0.5`: While aerial, open sites re-scan for parts this often (update_site adds parts without a tile_built), so a rising frame's new floor shows from the sky too.
- `RS_SETTINGS = { "atlas": "rendering/lights_and_shadows/directional_shadow/size", "atlas_16": "renderi...`: Project defaults of the global RenderingServer knobs (headless has no getters for them).
- `RS_DEFAULTS = { "atlas": 4096, "atlas_16": true, "soft": 2, "ssao": 2, "ssao_half": true, "ssao_targe...`
- `SHADOW_KEYS = [ "directional_shadow_max_distance", "directional_shadow_split_1", "directional_shadow_...`: The sun keys the aerial coverage widens (the reach, then the three cascade splits).
- `VIEWPORT_KEYS = [ "scaling_3d_mode", "scaling_3d_scale", "msaa_3d", "mesh_lod_threshold", "use_occlusio...`

### Properties

- `preset: String`: The applied preset: "low", "medium" or "high".
- `aerial: bool`: Aerial coverage on: the camera is over the city (the overview, a photo fly).
- `rs_calls: Dictionary`: Last arguments of every RenderingServer setter this feature called (headless has no getters).
- `active: bool`: The post-pass is live (on foot, set up).
- `frame_us: int`: Main-thread cost of this feature's per-frame work (µs): the last frame and the worst since reset_stats(); the bench reports both.
- `pass_us_max: int`: Worst single tile post-pass (µs) since reset_stats().
- `warm_us_max: int`: Worst warm step (one model proxy or one mid-LOD gather before a pass, µs) since reset_stats().
- `rebuild_us_max: int`: Worst chunk rebuild (impostor and occluder, µs) since reset_stats().
- `clock: Callable`: Microsecond clock for the frame budget; tests inject a fake one so budgets are deterministic.

### Functions

- `func feature_id() -> String`
- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func on_world_rebuilt() -> void`
- `func teardown() -> void`
- `func apply_preset(p: String) -> void`: Applies preset p (unknown names give Medium) to the viewport, the RenderingServer, the camera and the visibility ranges; cached parts are re-ranged over the next frames.
- `func preset_applied(p: String) -> bool`: True when the viewport and camera carry preset p's knobs (self-test and tests).
- `func set_aerial(on: bool) -> void`: Turns the aerial coverage on or off: while on, the camera is over the city, so road mains and twins (hlod.set_aerial, re-ranged through _job), far trees (CityView.set_aerial), open site parts (ConstructionKit.aerial_ranges), the fog end and the far plane widen to keep the whole city visible at every zoom. On exit each value is re-derived from the preset and the kit, never from an entry snapshot, so a preset or weather change mid-air cannot leave a stale value.
- `func job_pending() -> int`: Tiles still waiting to be re-ranged after a preset switch.
- `func pass_pending() -> int`: Tiles whose post-pass is still queued.
- `func flush() -> void`: Runs every pending re-range, post-pass, mid-LOD merge and chunk rebuild now (tests and tools).
- `func self_test() -> Dictionary`
- `func photo_shots() -> Array`: A skyline from a road just beyond the impostor switch, facing the tallest part of the city, by day and by night (the far buildings there are impostors).
- `func reset_stats() -> void`: Clears the worst-case timings (the bench calls it before each measurement).
